raw_response:
I am 63 this year, and I have worked my 4.1 mu in Quzhou County for 40 years. My husband and I do the labor ourselves. Our son works in a factory in Shijiazhuang and sends a little money home, but I do not count on it. I finished middle school, so I can read the numbers on a fertilizer bag and do the cost sums, but most of what I know comes from doing it year after year and watching what happens in my own fields.

This year I will keep 3 mu in the wheat-maize rotation and 1.1 mu in cotton. I thought about cutting the cotton back to half a mu because bending down to pick it hurts my waist now, but cotton prices were decent last year and Lao Wang from the east village said the input dealer has a reliable hybrid seed this year. Still, 1.1 mu is enough. More than that and the two of us cannot pick it all before the weather turns.

For the winter wheat on those 3 mu: I sow in mid-October with the same improved variety I used last year, about 15 kg of seed per mu. Before sowing, I spread 50 kg of compound fertilizer per mu — the 15-15-15 kind from the dealer. When the wheat turns green in late March, I top-dress with 15 kg of urea per mu. I will irrigate three times: once at green-up, once at the jointing stage in April, and once during grain filling in May. Last year I skipped the last irrigation to save on electricity, and the grain came out shriveled. I lost at least 50 kg per mu. This year I will not cut that corner. I spray twice for aphids and rust. I expect about 480 kg per mu if the spring drought does not hit too hard.

For summer maize on the same 3 mu: Right after cutting wheat in early June, I plant hybrid maize seed, about 2.5 kg per mu. No ploughing — I drill it straight into the wheat stubble, that is how everyone does it now. At planting I put 30 kg of compound fertilizer per mu in the rows. When the plants reach the big trumpet stage, I spread 20 kg of urea per mu. I irrigate twice: once at tasseling and once when the grain is filling. I spray twice, mainly for armyworms. I should get around 530 kg per mu.

For cotton on the 1.1 mu: I plant in late April with hybrid seed, about 1.5 kg per mu. Cotton eats a lot of potassium, so I use 40 kg of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu plus 15 kg of potassium chloride per mu as base fertilizer. I top-dress with urea twice, 10 kg each time — once at flowering and once at boll setting. I irrigate three times: at flowering, at boll setting, and again in August if it stays dry. I spray four times for bollworms and mites, I cannot skip that. I expect about 270 kg per mu of seed cotton.

I worry about costs every night. Compound fertilizer is about 160 yuan per 50 kg bag and urea is about 120 yuan per bag. I will spend roughly 1,800 yuan on fertilizer and pesticides for all crops this year. That is real money for us. But in 2016 I tried to save by using less fertilizer on the wheat, and I lost nearly 100 kg per mu. A bad harvest is a disaster; wasting some fertilizer is only a cost. I watch what my neighbors do, and most people around here use about the same amounts. If everyone puts one bag of compound fertilizer per mu on wheat, I do the same. I sleep better that way.
